sqlite_fts5_result.title: Data retention
sqlite_fts5_result.text: Customer records must follow the data retention schedule.

limits: One real composition task is not a comparative agent-quality benchmark.
Million task records do not measure a million active agents; no model or evaluation cost is included in synthetic queue throughput.
Declared associated witnesses and ordinary Python bodies remain trusted; no metatheoretic soundness proof or fresh generative identities.
Clean candidate environments are not an OS sandbox; untrusted code requires operator-provided isolation.
Repository federation is bounded read federation, without distributed snapshots or consensus.
Evidence authenticates finite observations and configured evaluator identities, not universal behavior or the best possible solution.
